Owen Callahan
owen.callahan@example.com | Charlotte, NC
Owen Callahan has 7 years of experience in frontend. Most recently, Senior
Frontend Developer at Copperfield Computing (2023-2026), where they partnered
with backend engineers at Copperfield Computing to consume REST and GraphQL
APIs. Before that, Frontend Developer at Vertex Platform (2020-2023). Before
that, Junior Frontend Developer at Beacon Networks (2019-2020). Education: B.S.
Software Engineering, Penn State University, 2018. Core skills: TypeScript,
JavaScript, Node.js, AWS, MongoDB, TypeScript.
